title: LIVE UPDATES: Sara Duterte Impeachment Trial (October 8, 2026)
summary: The impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte continues on Wednesday, October 8, 2026, at the Senate impeachment court. Here are the latest news and updates.

blocks.text: Sara Duterte impeachment trial Day 36: What to expect

The House prosecution panel is set to present on Thursday a witness from the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) to testify on Article 2 of the impeachment case, alleging that Vice President Sara Duterte accumulated unexplained wealth.
Set to be called to the witness stand this morning is BIR Office of the Commissioner chief of staff Atty. Anne Loraine Garcia-Marquez.

Impeachment court spokesperson Regie Tongol said that the BIR witness is expected to be asked about voluminous documents, including the income tax returns and audited financial statements of the Vice President and her husband, Manases Carpio.
